You are rebuilding every page of the **Vantro Esportes Guia** template, a satellite site (angle: sports-depth). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Portuguese); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

# Rebuild brief: Vantro Esportes Guia

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: a small brand site that answers the questions before sign-up: payments, sign-up, app, products and safer gambling.
- Home links every service page; each service page answers one question first, in its hero.
- Every page has its own title and meta description and a link back to related pages.
- Product pages (betting, casino) exist only where the market allows that product; home shows the matching odds board or game strip.
- Navigation styles (top menu, sidebar guide, hub of cards) change only the navigation, not the content.

## Market guidance

### Market context (from the market settings)

- Market: Brazil (`br`), languages pt, currency BRL (R$)
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports, casino
- Promotions allowed: none; not allowed: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code, odds_boost, cashback, loyalty, tournaments
- Payment methods: PIX, TED, Débito
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android both

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: Proibido para menores de 18 anos.
- Licence: Autorizada SPA/MF
- Self-exclusion: Você pode solicitar a autoexclusão a qualquer momento.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Minimum age is 18: the age gate and every age line say 18+.
- Show only these payment methods: PIX, TED, Débito.
- Amounts are in BRL (R$).

### Market-specific rules

- Only licensed operators with .bet.br domains; links go to the .bet.br domain.
- Credit cards are never shown as a payment method.
- Identity and age are verified with CPF before play.

## Site context

- Site: Vantro Esportes Guia (https://vantro-esportes.example), brand or publisher: Vantro
- Site type: satellite, angle sports-depth; language `pt`, text direction `ltr`
- Pages (5):
  - `index.html` — Vantro: apostas em futebol, vôlei e basquete ao vivo
  - `sign-up.html` — Cadastro na Vantro: CPF, reconhecimento facial e prazo
  - `payments.html` — Depósito e saque na Vantro: PIX, TED e cartão de débito
  - `betting.html` — Mercados da Vantro: futebol, vôlei, basquete e mais
  - `responsible-gambling.html` — Jogo responsável na Vantro: limites, pausas e autoexclusão

Fonts (Google Fonts): Oswald, Roboto Condensed.

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Hero: Exactly one primary CTA. The secondary action is a text link or ghost button.
- Hero: Primary CTA must sit above the fold at 375x667.
- Hero: Headline 60 characters max; subtitle 160 max (long Russian/Portuguese strings included).
- Hero: scoreboard: the match card is an illustration and must carry a note saying odds are examples.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Features: 3 or 4 items. Titles 4 words max, text one sentence (about 120 characters).
- Features: Features describe the product, never an offer or bonus.
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Payments: Only methods listed in the market config may appear (no credit cards in AU or BR).
- Payments: Times are typical for verified accounts and say so in the note.
- Showcase: Odds and fixtures are illustrations; the note saying so is required.
- Showcase: Never placed directly after the hero (blueprint order rule).

## Page `index.html`

- Title tag: Vantro: apostas em futebol, vôlei e basquete ao vivo
- The only H1: Futebol, vôlei e basquete com odds ao vivo
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `index.html`, `sign-up.html`, `payments.html`, `betting.html`, `responsible-gambling.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `note`: "Autorizada SPA/MF"
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
2. **Hero** — block `sx/hero`, variant `scoreboard`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Above-the-fold hero: headline, one primary CTA, trust row and an optional offer/feature card.
   - `eyebrow`: "Brasileirão · 34ª rodada"
   - `title`: "Futebol, vôlei e basquete com odds ao vivo"
   - `subtitle`: "Mais de 150 mercados por jogo do Brasileirão, estatísticas em tempo real e saque via PIX em cerca de 1 hora."
   - `secondary`: `{"label":"Ver os mercados","url":"page:betting"}`
   - `show_trust`: true
   - `match`: `{"league":"Série A · 34ª rodada","clock":"2º T 67'","home":{"name":"Porto Alegre FC","short":"POA","color":"#1F6FEB","score":"1"},"away":{"name":"Recife Atlético","short":"REC","color":"#C62839","score":"1"},"markets":[{"label":"Resultado final","odds":[{"pick":"POA","price":"2,40"},{"pick":"Empate","price":"2,10"},{"pick":"REC","price":"4,20"}]},{"label":"Total de gols","odds":[{"pick":"Mais de 2,5","price":"2,55"},{"pick":"Menos de 2,5","price":"1,48"}]},{"label":"Próximo gol","odds":[{"pick":"POA","price":"1,95"},{"pick":"REC","price":"2,90"}]}],"note":"Mercados de exemplo, apenas ilustrativos. As odds ao vivo mudam durante a partida."}`
   - `art`: "rings"
3. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `badges`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
4. **Features** — block `sx/features`, variant `bento`, role `content`
   Purpose: 3-4 product reasons to join, each with an icon, a short title and one sentence.
   - `eyebrow`: "Por que apostar na Vantro"
   - `title`: "O que você encontra na conta"
   - `items`: `[{"icon":"layers","title":"Crie sua aposta","text":"Combine resultado, gols, escanteios e cartões do mesmo jogo."},{"icon":"gauge","title":"Estatísticas ao vivo","text":"Posse, finalizações e mapa de calor ao lado das odds."},{"icon":"bolt","title":"Saque via PIX","text":"A maioria dos saques cai em cerca de 1 hora, todos os dias."},{"icon":"shield","title":"Limites sob controle","text":"Limite diário, semanal ou mensal de depósito em dois toques."}]`
5. **Steps** — block `sx/steps`, variant `timeline`, role `content`
   Purpose: Three real steps from sign-up to first bet, followed by the mid-page CTA.
   - `eyebrow`: "Como começar"
   - `title`: "Comece em três passos"
   - `items`: `[{"title":"Cadastre-se com CPF","text":"Nome, CPF e data de nascimento, mais uma selfie para a verificação facial."},{"title":"Deposite via PIX","text":"A partir de R$ 10, de uma conta no seu CPF. Defina um limite de depósito."},{"title":"Faça sua aposta","text":"Escolha um mercado, adicione ao cupom e confirme."}]`
   - `show_cta`: true
6. **Page links** — block `sx/page-links`, variant `cards`, role `content`
   Purpose: Links to the site's other pages with a one-line blurb: service pages on home, related pages elsewhere.
7. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `columns`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"A Vantro é autorizada no Brasil?","a":"Sim. A Vantro é autorizada pela Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas do Ministério da Fazenda e opera no domínio vantro.bet.br. O número da portaria está no rodapé."},{"q":"Quanto tempo leva o cadastro?","a":"Poucos minutos. A verificação facial costuma ser concluída na hora; você aposta assim que a conta é aprovada."},{"q":"Qual a forma de saque mais rápida?","a":"PIX. A maioria dos saques via PIX cai em cerca de 1 hora na conta do seu CPF."},{"q":"Posso usar cartão de crédito?","a":"Não. A regulamentação brasileira proíbe cartão de crédito em apostas. Use PIX, TED ou cartão de débito."},{"q":"Como defino um limite de depósito?","a":"No cadastro ou depois, em Conta → Jogo responsável. Reduções valem na hora."}]`
8. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `split`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Pronto para a próxima rodada"
   - `text`: "Abra sua conta na Vantro em poucos minutos. Proibido para menores de 18 anos."
   - `show_code`: false
9. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `cards`
     - `show_verify`: false
10. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `sheet`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
11. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `pill`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.
